reasons: Compliant status is supported by the cited text: Section 14 (p0079) gives Client an unconditional, no-cause right to stop the Hosting/Support Services on written notice, with service continuing only to the last day of the month following the notice month (~30–60 days effective notice) and no early-termination fee, penalty or clawback anywhere in the agreement — at or within the preferred/fallback band.

Vendor side is directionally correct: TrueLink has no mid-term convenience exit (only for-cause termination of Sections 2–3 on Client breach or a System/Credit Repository default, per p0078), and the term is a 1-year auto-renewing term, so the multi-year walk-away trigger does not apply.

The failed 'Customer convenience termination present' regex is a phrasing artifact — Section 14 expresses the right functionally ('election to terminate this Agreement') without the word 'convenience' — and does not undercut substance.

Shortfalls are correctly treated as sub-elements noted in the rationale rather than redlined: absence of an express pro-rata refund (moot given monthly arrears invoicing at p0045), the 30-day mutual non-renewal notice (an end-of-term, symmetrical non-renewal rather than a vendor mid-term convenience right), and the 'Subject to Section 4' blank minimum-commitment cross-reference.

No redline or comment is proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the record is usable as internal evidence with a flagged drafting point (Section 13's mis-cross-reference to Section 12 and the unfilled Section 4 commitment blank) for negotiation follow-up.
